name: What types of flooring are suitable for foreclosed properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring are suitable for foreclosed properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting flooring for a foreclosed property often prioritizes durability, cost-effectiveness, and appeal to future buyers or tenants. Popular choices include luxury vinyl plank (LVP) for its water resistance and mimicry of wood/tile, laminate for its affordability and ease of installation, and carpet for bedrooms to add comfort and sound insulation. Hardwood can be an excellent long-term investment, especially if the existing subfloor is in good condition. The best choice depends on the property's overall renovation budget, target market, and expected use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable and cost-effective options like luxury vinyl plank, laminate, and carpet are popular for foreclosed properties. Hardwood can also be a good investment.
